correctness.rationale: Divisor-sum equivalence is valid for smooth plane cubics with rational flex in characteristic >=5. Complete finite enumeration of 296010 six-subsets, all GL2(F2) and GL2(F3) conjugacy classes, and their induced cycles gives the exact 24-row, 19-spectrum certificate. No finite sample is substituted for universal proof: reduction to 24 finite cases uses the mod-six Galois representation and Weil pairing determinant.

originality.rationale: The accessible primary full text arXiv:2211.00494, Sections 2–4, gives Fermat-cubic geometry and its 81/8244 counts but not a general 24-class arithmetic reconstruction theorem. arXiv:2101.03824, Sections 1 and 6, treats intrinsic sextactic torsion on arbitrary cubics, not finite-field six-secant-conic zeta data. A closely relevant published arithmetic record gives the Fermat specialization including 5976/0/22, which is covered and excluded as a new contribution. The claimed novelty is specifically the universal reduction of the five joint zeta functions to (q mod 3, sextactic count, conic count) across all 24 class pairs; no equivalent universal two-count claim was identified. It remains possible that an unindexed finite group table implicitly contains it.
residual_risks: Full text of the most similar public Fermat-specific arithmetic finding could not be inspected here.
A general permutation-character table or unrelated elliptic level-six study may implicitly include the 24-row injection.
No claim that every abstract conjugacy-class pair occurs over any fixed finite field.
